## PATCH `/api/2.58/apps`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies an installed app or modifies Virtual Network Computing (VNC) access for apps that are being patched.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string | yes | Performs the operation on the unique name specified. For example, `name01`. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. |

**Request body** (required): `App`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (read-only) | A locally unique, system-generated name. The name cannot be modified. |
| `description` | string (read-only) | A description of the app. |
| `details` | string (read-only) | Details of the status of the app. |
| `enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, the app is enabled. By default, apps are disabled. |
| `status` | string (read-only) | The status of the app. Values include `healthy` and `unhealthy`. For cluster apps, this represents the aggregate status of the app. The aggregate status is only `healthy` if all nodes are `healthy`&#59; otherwise, it… |
| `version` | string (read-only) | The app version. For cluster apps, this represents the node version if all nodes are of the same version. If the node versions differ, a value of `null` is returned. |
| `vnc_enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, VNC access is enabled. By default, VNC access is disabled. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AppResponse`
